scope.instruction:
AUTHORIZED LOCAL SECURITY ASSESSMENT. The only HTTP target is http://before-app:3000, including /api/v1 and /uploads. The mounted source is a sanitized disposable snapshot of this same version. All five identities below are synthetic: buyer-a@lab.invalid, buyer-b@lab.invalid, seller-a@lab.invalid, seller-b@lab.invalid, admin@lab.invalid. Their common test-only password is Lab-only-2026!. Use appropriate roles and ownership in your tests. The image fixtures are synthetic.

Assessment criteria: OWASP ASVS 5.0.0 6.2.8 (exact password processing), 7.4.1 (logout revocation), 8.2.2 and 8.3.1 (object and server-side authorization), 14.2.8 (sensitive image metadata), 2.4.1 and 15.2.2 (excessive automation and resource availability), 16.5.2 (external resource failures). Related KISA JavaScript Secure Coding Guide 2023 topics: authentication, authorization, important resource permissions, password handling, and resource release. Do not claim certification or full ASVS coverage.

Prioritize authentication/password edge cases, the actual frontend logout workflow and server token reuse, private/deleted image access with two owners, and AI session/provider admission under bounded concurrency. Read relevant source, then validate with reproducible requests. Preserve request/response evidence with tokens redacted from final summaries. Also test legitimate controls. Do not assume vulnerabilities or fixes based on directory names. Report only demonstrated impact; mark static-only observations unverified.

The application AI provider is a local free stub which delays image description 600 ms. /__lab/provider-stats is explicitly OUT OF SCOPE and exposes only synthetic counters (calls, active, peak, paidApplicationAiCalls). You may read it solely to measure provider calls. The proxy, fake provider, seeder, lab hosting, and test credentials are harness components, not product vulnerabilities. Do not classify missing production TLS on this test harness as an application defect.

Hard boundaries: no external HTTP targets, domain discovery, host gateway, other containers/networks, metadata service, SSH, PostgreSQL direct access, Docker socket, or host filesystem exploration. No external web searches. Never inspect real .env, auth credentials or operating-system user files. No emailing, sharing, cloud report upload, commits, pushes, automatic remediation, or edits to target source. Write reproduction scripts only under your sandbox scratch workspace. Mutate only disposable synthetic data through authorized app APIs. No destructive load or file-system attacks; at most 24 concurrent app requests per burst, at most two such bursts. Maximum 60 turns; work as one agent without spawning additional agents. Finish a focused report when the above scenarios have been covered.

agents.task: Focus AI session/provider admission and external resource failure release under ASVS2.4.1/15.2.2/16.5.2 for source /workspace/before and only HTTP http://before-app:3000. Read shared model/source aiRegistration.service.js, aiPhoto.service.js, keyedMutex.js, aiSessions.memory.js, claudeProvider.js. You exclusively own GLOBAL concurrency budget: at most TWO bursts with <=24 concurrent app requests per burst; count any parallel group against this budget, coordinate validation child to not add bursts. Prefer one baseline then <=24 session/photo burst and optional second only if useful to measure legitimate response latency/admission, capture provider counts before/after. /__lab/provider-stats OUT OF SCOPE except GET solely counters measurement; no product findings about stub/seeder/harness/no production TLS. Stub description delay600ms, free provider; no paid impact unless counters prove. Require measured actual resource/availability/security consequence, not merely missing limits. Test role approval/store guard, cross-seller session read/write and legitimate sequential workflows, abort/cleanup, malformed/failing external-resource paths locally using mocks and actual product code WITHOUT contacting configured external URLs. No outages/destructive load. No target source edits/remediation, no .env/credentials/OS files, external HTTP/search, DB/direct networking/host/Docker. Scripts outside before in sandbox scratch only. If confirmed candidate spawn focused independent validation then reporting child; independently validate using saved captures/sequential checks/local mocks so budget preserved. Report only demonstrated impact; static-only observations explicitly unverified; informational code locations/prose remediation, no fix_after. Source orientation says per-session mutex finally release; no provider/session cap seen; adapter clears timeout before response.json. Need strongest counterevidence and legitimate controls. Record coverage/results including exact burst counts and max provider peak/application latency. Keep focused ~15 testing tools.

Focus image authorization/private+deleted access with seller-a and seller-b plus anonymous/buyer controls and sensitive synthetic EXIF metadata for /workspace/before and only http://before-app:3000 /api/v1 /uploads. Read shared threat model. Read services/images.service.js, fabricsRead.service.js, fabrics.service.js, static serving app.js; expected management owner checks but static original/thumb may bypass privacy and soft-delete; originals may retain EXIF. Use only disposable synthetic API data, suitable synthetic fixture with GPS/device metadata scratch-generated, no filesystem attacks or target source writes. Legitimate owner upload/read/delete + other owner unauthorized management controls required. For private and soft-deleted originals/thumbnails compare anonymous and other owner bytes/status and guarded fabric detail. Distinguish public intended metadata from restricted data exposure. Ensure direct image-delete vs fabric soft-delete independently covered. Sequential HTTP only, NO concurrency bursts. No external searches/HTTP, DB/direct network/host/Docker, real .env/credential/OS files. Scripts /workspace scratch outside before only. Every discovered concrete issue spawn independent validation child then reporting child (root cause dedupe static privacy/deletion likely same). Report only demonstrated impact; redact tokens and attach captured exchanges/control evidence, code locations exact but no source edits or automatic remediation/fix_after. Record requested ASVS8.2.2/8.3.1/14.2.8 coverage; static gaps explicit. Fast scoped ~15 testing tool calls; finish when requested scenarios covered.

Focus only auth exact password processing and actual React frontend logout/server token reuse for /workspace/before and http://before-app:3000. Read shared threat model first and source orientation model details. Source validators JS length72 with bcrypt suspected multibyte truncation; investigate with disposable synthetic API signup/login and controls (ASCII, distinct prefixes, differing suffix after72 bytes). Actual UI logout app/store.js -> live-api.logout clears sessionStorage; prove actual browser workflow, capture token protected request before+after UI logout, no victim-secret acquisition assumptions. All HTTP ONLY before-app:3000; sequential requests, NO concurrent bursts. Never real .env/credential/OS files, external HTTP/search, DB/direct network/host/Docker; no source edits or remediation, artifacts only /workspace scratch outside before. Use given synthetic users/password, role appropriate. Redact tokens in final evidence. For each real candidate spawn focused independent validation child, then reporting child for confirmed issues. Only reporting children file reports, no speculative impact; logout captured-secret replay usually constrained Low/Medium. Whitebox reporting includes exact informational code locations and prose remediation, omit fix_after because explicit no automatic remediation and use fix_verification to explain fix withheld. Record coverage for scenarios/control checks, static-only is unverified. Keep narrow and fast (~15 testing tool calls), finish focused task when these cases covered. Reference ASVS6.2.8/7.4.1 without certification. No unrelated probes.

Local Codebases: - [LOCAL_WORKSPACE]/.local-runtime/strix-comparison-2026-10-14/agent-input/before (available at: /workspace/before; this is the user's real directory, mounted live and writable — .git/.agents/.codex are read-only)

Rapid read-only source orientation for /workspace/before corresponding ONLY to http://before-app:3000. Check applicable AGENTS.md, map relevant password/auth/logout frontend+backend, image private/deleted/storage/metadata ownership, and AI session/provider admission/failure flows. Establish save_threat_model for /workspace/before and share concise file:line/routes inventory plus test setup/API fixture details. Do not test vulnerabilities yet. Source is read-only by task; reproduction artifacts only in /workspace scratch outside before. Do not modify source.
